summary: CVE-2026-93516 affecting package xorg-x11-server-Xwayland for versions less than 24.1.14-1
details: A use-after-free caused by lack of lifecycle management when adding / removing XInput master devices in X.org X Server before 21.1.25 and XWayland before 24.1.14 could be used by authenticated X Clients to crash the X server or potentially execute code in X server context.
